title: Production batch and packaged physical inventory pure domain
selectedSlice: A — production-batch + packaged physical inventory pure domain only
evidence: No canonical FOOD model currently establishes physical quantity-on-hand.
No canonical FOOD model currently establishes production-batch authority.
The product vision requires future inventory to distinguish made-to-order from frozen inventory.
Frozen inventory may later require quantity-on-hand, production batch, frozen date, package count, reserved quantity, sold quantity and storage state.
The operating architecture requires batch codes and preserves exact product/version history.
Generic food_sku_capacity_sources storage must not itself be treated as physical inventory authority.

domain.purpose: Immutable evidence that a specific number of packaged units for one exact SKU/version were physically produced in one batch.

semantics: SKU reference version is a positive safe integer.
producedPackageCount is historical production evidence and not current quantity-on-hand.
batch identity binds one exact SKU ID/version.
production batch does not establish availability, orderability or reservable capacity.
